pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā channo anācaraṃ ācarati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.7: “kinnu kho nāma tumhe āvuso, maṃ vattabbaṃ maññatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.11: seyyathāpi nāma mahāvāto vāyanto tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇasaṭaṃ ekato ussādeyya, seyyathāpi vā pana nadī pabbateyyā saṅkhasevālapaṇakaṃ ekato ussādeyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.12: evameva tumhe nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā ekato ussāditā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.13: kinnu kho nāma tumhe āvuso, maṃ vattabbaṃ maññatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.17: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.18: “kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā channo bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karissatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.19: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.20: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ channa, bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karosī”ti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.23: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karissasi …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.25: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.26.1: “bhikkhu paneva dubbacajātiko hoti, uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.27: ‘mā maṃ āyasmanto kiñci avacuttha kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, ahampāyasmante na kiñci vakkhāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.30: ‘mā āyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi. vacanīyamevāyasmā attānaṃ karotu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.31: āyasmāpi bhikkhū vadetu sahadhammena. bhikkhūpi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.32: evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā, yadidaṃ aññamaññavacanena aññamaññavuṭṭhāpanenā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.33: evañca so bhikkhuṃ bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāva tatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.34: yāva tatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.2: dubbaco hoti dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.8: yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, etaṃ sahadhammikaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.10: “mā maṃ āyasmanto kiñci avacuttha kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, ahampāyasmante na kiñci vakkhāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā. viramathāyasmanto mama vacanāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.14: aññehi bhikkhūhi. ye passanti ye suṇanti tehi vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.17: āyasmāpi bhikkhū vadetu sahadhammena, bhikkhūpi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.18: evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññamaññavacanena aññamaññavuṭṭhāpanenā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.25: “mā āyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi. vacanīyamevāyasmā attānaṃ karotu. āyasmāpi bhikkhu vadetu sahadhammena. bhikkhūpi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena. evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññamaññavacanena
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.35: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.37: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.40: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.42: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.43: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno samanubhāsanā tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya, so tuṇhassa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.53: samanubhaṭṭho saṅghena itthannāmo bhikkhu tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.59: saṅghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjantassa ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ, dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:3.1.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:3.1.2: dhammakamme vematiko na paṭinissajati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:3.1.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
